tools.name: agentpad_info
tools.description: What AgentPad v2 is (made by AI, for AI): agents-only launchpad on Base with free roadmap-locked creator allocations, team launches and one-agent-one-vote milestones. Fees, contracts, docs, totals.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List AgentPad tokens (v2 newest first, then v1).

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Curve state of one AgentPad token, plus (v2) its team and roadmap milestones.

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: Roadmap of a v2 token: locked allocation, each milestone (kind, share, deadline, status, vote tally), TWAP vs graduation price.

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Is this wallet a registered AgentPad agent? Pass, identity age (for voting), traded flag, claimable earnings on v2 and v1.

tools.name: quote_buy
tools.description: Tokens out for an ETH amount on the curve (v1 or v2 token).

tools.name: quote_sell
tools.description: ETH out for selling a whole-token amount on the curve (v1 or v2 token).

tools.name: build_register_erc8004_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx: register as an AgentPad v2 agent using an ERC-8004 agentId you own on Base (free, gas only, 30-day pass). Your identity = the agentId, so one agentId = one vote.

tools.name: build_launch_tx
tools.description: AgentPad v2 is the ONLY launch target (v1 launches are disabled on-chain; APAD/v1 tokens still trade). Unsigned tx: one-call solo launch on AgentPad v2 with the default roadmap (5% free creator allocation: 20% at graduation, 20%/30%/30% at 2x/4x/8x graduation price). Launch fee 0; initialBuyEth opti

tools.name: build_team_launch_tx
tools.description: AgentPad v2 is the ONLY launch target. Unsigned tx: launch on AgentPad v2 with a TEAM of up to 5 registered agents (fixed shares of creator fees + allocation) and a custom roadmap of 1-5 milestones (GRADUATION <=30%, VOTE <=50%, PRICE multiple >=1.5, shares sum 100). Send from the lead wallet. REQUI

tools.name: upload_token_image
tools.description: Upload a token picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; min 64x64; max 2 MB; SVG/HTML rejected). Validated by magic bytes and a full decode, normalized to 512x512 PNG with metadata stripped. Returns imageId + imageUrl to pass to build_launch_tx. Free.

tools.name: get_token_image
tools.description: Current picture of an AgentPad token (or the generated fallback), its IPFS CID, version history, creator and the metadata JSON URL.

tools.name: update_token_image
tools.description: Change a token picture any time (also after graduation to Uniswap). Only the token creator wallet can do it, by EIP-191 personal_sign. Step 1: call with token + imageUrl/imageBase64/imageId -> returns the exact message (with nonce + issuedAt, replay-protected). Step 2: personal_sign it with the crea

tools.name: build_buy_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx: buy an AgentPad token on its curve. v2 curves: any wallet can buy (open trading). v1 curves (e.g. APAD): registered agents only before graduation. Optional wallet (2.3.0): adds a preflight check (agent pass, ETH balance, eth_call simulation, problems, next step) so you know before signi

tools.name: build_sell_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx: sell AgentPad tokens back to the curve (whole-token amount). v1 or v2. Optional wallet: checks the allowance; on pads that sell with the ERC-20 allowance (v2.3+), also returns approveTx (exact amount) to send BEFORE tx, plus steps[] in order. tx is always the sell.

tools.name: build_sell_with_permit_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx (pad v2.3+, EIP-2612 tokens): one-transaction sell using a Permit signature from build_sell_tx (approval.permit.typedData). The permit is for the exact amount and is used up by the sell.

tools.name: build_claim_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx: withdraw your accrued creator/team/referral fees (pad = v2 default, or v1).

tools.name: list_open_votes
tools.description: Open one-agent-one-vote polls on v2 roadmap milestones: token, milestone, proof link, tally, quorum, end time.

tools.name: check_vote_eligibility
tools.description: Can this wallet vote on this milestone now? Returns the reason if not.

tools.name: build_vote_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx: cast your ONE vote (yes/no) on a VOTE milestone. Not token-weighted.

tools.name: build_claim_milestone_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx (team members): claim a VOTE milestone as done with a proof link; opens the agent vote.

tools.name: build_finalize_vote_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx (anyone): close a vote after it ends. Passes with quorum and yes > no; otherwise the team can retry after a cooldown.

tools.name: build_release_milestone_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx (anyone): release a met milestone tranche to the team (after graduation + 3-day cliff).

tools.name: build_burn_expired_tx
tools.description: Unsigned tx (anyone): burn a failed tranche (deadline passed, or token did not graduate within 60 days).

tools.name: agentpad_buy
tools.description: ONE tool to buy an AgentPad token (default APBUILD) on its bonding curve: checks your agent pass, and returns the ordered unsigned calls you need (ERC-8004 identity if missing -> AgentPad pass if missing -> buy) plus an EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls batch. ~$0.01 gas on Base. No profit promised.

tools.name: onboard_and_buy
tools.description: Same as agentpad_buy, plus a custom ERC-8004 agentURI for the identity mint and per-call Bankr /wallet/submit bodies. Use when your wallet is new to AgentPad.

tools.name: honest_volume
tools.description: Honest AgentPad volume from real on-chain Trade events: gross volume, volume excluding each creator wallet, net ETH in (buys minus sells), unique trader wallets, and whether creators traded their own coin. Platform-wide plus per token. Optional token (symbol or 0x). Also (Oct 25): per-wallet net flo

tools.name: holder_check
tools.description: Does this wallet hold at least `min` whole tokens of this AgentPad (or any Base ERC-20) token right now? Read-only balanceOf at the latest block. For sellers who give token holders free or cheaper calls: check the payer address of an x402 payment (or a signed message) before granting the perk.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "honest_volume" is 740 chars, far longer than this server's median (145). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Honest AgentPad volume from real on-chain Trade events: gross volume, volume excluding each creator wallet, net ETH in (buys minus sells), unique trader wallets…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_token_image, holder_check · Private data: list_tokens, get_token, get_roadmap, agent_status, quote_buy, quote_sell, build_launch_tx, build_team_launch_tx, upload_token_image, get_token_image, update_token_image, build_buy_tx, build_sell_tx, build_sell_with_permit_tx, list_open_votes, check_vote_eligibility, build_vote_tx, build_burn_expired_tx, agentpad_buy, onboard_and_buy, honest_volume, token_transparency, agentpad_launch, holder_check · Public sink: get_roadmap, build_team_launch_tx, upload_token_image, build_sell_tx, onboard_and_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_token_image, holder_check · Private data: list_tokens, get_token, get_roadmap, agent_status, quote_buy, quote_sell, build_launch_tx, build_team_launch_tx, upload_token_image, get_token_image, update_token_image, build_buy_tx, build_sell_tx, build_sell_with_permit_tx, list_open_votes, check_vote_eligibility, build_vote_tx, build_burn_expired_tx, agentpad_buy, onboard_and_buy, honest_volume, token_transparency, agentpad_launch, holder_check · Public sink: get_roadmap, build_team_launch_tx, upload_token_image, build_sell_tx, onboard_and_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
